scope: Server MVP performance profile (step 1, milestone 2 follow-up): integration/fixtures/server-robustness served by native Lean 4.35.0 (leanc -O2) and by Lasm in Node 26.12.0, plus in-process micro-benchmarks (scripts/server-mvp/profile/Main.lean). Linux x64 only, local host.

builds.server: .work/server-robustness/build-f1 (installed .54 plus both pending fixes, scripts/server-mvp/overlay-fix.mjs variant full; wasm 2986350 B, link -Oz -g1)
builds.bench: scripts/server-mvp/build-profile.mjs with the same compiler (runs b2 for p2, b3 for p3)

host.note: Another maintainer workload (leak soak, 8 connections) ran between, not during, these bounded runs; host load average was 1-8 on 12 threads. Ratios measured in the same run are more reliable than absolute numbers.

method.harness: scripts/server-mvp/profile.mjs under scripts/full-lean/run-bounded.mjs (6 GiB cap); peaks 0.77 GiB (p2) and 3.48 GiB incl. bench build
method.instrumentation: scripts/server-mvp/profile-instrument.mjs patches a copy of program.cjs: per-operation RPC counts, main-thread time, worker-measured round trips (piggybacked on the next request), main-thread performance.eventLoopUtilization(); startup marks
method.load: keep-alive raw-socket client, 2 s warmup + 8 s measured per row; per-thread CPU from /proc/PID/task/*/stat
method.cpuprof: node --cpu-prof (all isolates, 500 us) of the uninstrumented Lasm server under health c=16; Wasm frames are unnamed (-g1, no name section), wasm-function[850] identified by disassembly as emscripten_futex_wait (contains memory.atomic.wait32)
method.opt: wasm-opt (Emscripten 6.0.9 Binaryen) -O2/-O3 applied on top of the delivered -Oz binary; table slots verified unchanged

mainThreadLoadWindow.note: 8 s load window of the main-thread profile (self time %)

opt.note: wasm-opt applied on top of the delivered -Oz binary (the link recipe runs -Oz then metadce); not identical to a fresh -O3 link.

summary.bottleneck: Node main thread servicing host RPCs: 58 RPCs per keep-alive health request (63 with a new connection each), 47-64 us main-thread CPU per RPC; main-thread ELU 0.92-0.93 at c=16; Lasm plateaus near 330 req/s for every route. Worker threads are ~95-99% in emscripten_futex_wait.

startupMs.codeCache: none (no streaming compile; v8.serialize gives a 2-byte in-process handle)

opportunities.change: Fuse async protocol (start+93+91 -> 1; 92 carries result, drop 90)
Shared-memory RPC slot + synchronous handling of sync ops, no reply clone, no Error stacks on cancel
opportunities.gain: per-RPC main CPU 47-64 us -> ~10-20 us; 2-3x ceiling

opportunities.change: Date header: cheap small read-only file reads (zoneinfo) or app generateDate:=false; upstream cache
Not worth now: -O3/-O2, fewer pool threads, Wasm code cache, buffer transfer
